text:
Maya L: Quick question for everyone — we're getting inconsistent self-assessments: some folks paste long project histories, others write 2 sentences. Can we publish a short guidance on expected length, optional attachments, and whether managers need to include a 'manager summary' cover note with their review?
Roberto F: +1. From calibration we want comparable inputs. Maybe cap self-assessments at ~500 words and allow up to 2 attachments (one PDF, one image) for evidence.
Priya S: I like caps. Also recommend a short template: Context (1-2 lines), Impact (3-4 bullets), Growth areas (2 bullets), Ask/Role clarity (1 line). That will help calibrators scan quickly.
Maya L: Nice. Can we make attachments optional and ask employees to name files with "Lastname_role_year" so calibrators can find them? E.g., "Lopez_SE_2026.pdf"
Roberto F: Good naming convention. Also suggest we auto-strip very large attachments (>10MB) and ask employees to link to company drive instead.
Priya S: Add an explicit statement: manager cover note is optional but encouraged for any rating that deviates from peer norm by >1 band. That keeps extra context for outliers.
Juno (HR Bot): I can append guidance to the form: max 500 words, max 2 attachments total, attachment size limit 10MB, required filename pattern = Lastname_ROLE_YEAR. I can also add a checkbox for "Manager Cover Note (recommended for rating deviations)" which managers can use when submitting. Confirm and I will update the form text and post an announcement.
Maya L: Confirmed. Please also add a 1-sentence example for each template section so people have a model.
Roberto F: Also add a short note to calibrators: "If no manager cover note and rating is an outlier, ask manager for quick context during reconciliation".
Priya S: Will draft the short announcement with the template and post within the hour. Thanks!
Juno (HR Bot): Updating form fields now. I will post the finalized guidance link once live.
